name: sandboxing rejects ANSI escape in intent
description: Schema rejects U+001B (ESC) in intent. ANSI escape sequences can manipulate terminal display and are used in some prompt-injection patterns to confuse human reviewers reading awareness state in a terminal.
notes: Pattern: terminal-control smuggling. THREAT_MODEL section 5.3 'smuggled control tokens'. ESC bytes are JSON-escaped so the fixture file is RFC 8259-conformant; the decoded string still contains U+001B which the #Intent regex rejects.
